issues.title: RFI Channel for P9
issues.body:
JP indicated that he would like an RFI channel for P9.

That will be an instance of `CollabChannel`.

Here is a channel definition that can go into `wargame-l6nngxlk.sqlite`.  The first document in the database is a wargame definition.  Open it up, navigate to the `channels` section, and insert this definition after the first `ChannelPlanning`.

Once the channel is inserted, login as `Game Control`, and there will be a single message in the channel.  

I've made a start on this issue, and made some fixes in this branch: 2367_collab_channel - it's in PR #2370 

Hmm, instead of inserting the channel into the wargame, maybe it's possible to debug things from the CollabMessageDetail `Collaborative Response` story: http://localhost:6611/?path=/story/local-molecules-collabmessagedetail--collaborative-response&args=state:Unallocated

Note, we seem to have these issues: 
- [ ] the `jsoneditor` for editing the `chat` response isn't working.
- [ ] the message titles ('Chat' and 'Response') aren't legible, since they are in black 
- [ ] I haven't been able to do any wider testing, so we should check `umpire force` roles can claim, review, and submit messages, and `blue` force roles can submit requests, and view released responses.
